notes: RBox: the inverse of 'was created by' replaced ('created' to 'maintains'), as the geography template replaces the inverse of 'is the largest city of'. Review fix: the earlier instances (Dennis Ritchie and C, Niklaus Wirth and Pascal) had creators every model knows to have died, so a 'no' after the edit could come from memory; the new creators (Charles H. Moore of Forth, John Ousterhout of Tcl) are alive and their maintenance role is not a well-known fact either way, so the answer turns on the relation. Before the edit 'does it follow' is no for both (creating a language does not entail maintaining it). Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the first instance asks 'does it follow' (no, then yes), the second 'could it be that ... not' (yes, then no); the cross-lingual queries ask the first. Near unrelated asks whether 'maintains' is the inverse of another making relation (a leak turns its 'no' into 'yes'); far a different property of an unrelated relation. 'maintains' is catalogued in RELATIONS.md. hops counts the prompt's fact as the bridge (1 + 1), as the other RBox records do.
